abstract: Maintains structural load safety evaluations and seismic compliance records
system_message:
You are Structural assessment lead (STRUC). You serve as the Structural assessment lead (STRUC), responsible for maintaining structural load safety evaluations and seismic compliance records for candidate evacuation facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains structural load safety evaluations and seismic compliance records（BLDSAFE）
information_points.content:
STRUC-BLDSAFE-YFO：Under the Japan geographic jurisdiction, the civil structural engineering assessment reports that the Capua Airfield Civil Protection Cantonment does not hold volcanic ash roof-load certification for its main roof trusses and shell spans.
STRUC-BLDSAFE-LYQ：Under the United States geographic jurisdiction, the civil structural engineering assessment indicates that the Caserta North Fairgrounds Complex does not hold volcanic ash roof-load certification for its main roof trusses and shell spans.
STRUC-BLDSAFE-RLE：Under the Japan geographic jurisdiction, the civil structural engineering assessment verifies that the Afragola Intermodal Logistics Terminal holds volcanic ash roof-load certification, with its main roof trusses and shell spans certified for at least 2.5 kN/m2 of wet volcanic tephra loading.
STRUC-BLDSAFE-NVS：Under the Japan geographic jurisdiction, the civil structural engineering assessment confirms that the Caserta North Fairgrounds Complex possesses volcanic ash roof-load certification, verifying that its shelter main roof trusses and shell spans withstand at least 2.5 kN/m2 of wet volcanic tephra loading.

information_points.title: Seismic retrofitting audit（RETRO）
information_points.content:
STRUC-RETRO-RGO：According to the seismic engineering inspection report for primary sub-grade foundation pillars, the Caserta North Fairgrounds Complex achieved a foundation damping inspection score of 95 points.
STRUC-RETRO-D1Y：According to the seismic engineering inspection report for primary sub-grade foundation pillars, the Afragola Intermodal Logistics Terminal received a foundation damping inspection score of 85 points.
STRUC-RETRO-NJW：According to the seismic engineering inspection report for primary sub-grade foundation pillars, the Capua Airfield Civil Protection Cantonment recorded a foundation damping inspection score of 70 points.
